name: platform-dashboard-analytics-providers
executionConcern: Platform Control change/rollout state, Providers registry/health, Platform policies and truthful dashboard/analytics read models
objective: Move every platform/provider mutation to its sovereign owner and make dashboard/analytics health/freshness truthful under success, restriction, partial failure and conflict.
truthOwner: Platform Control owns governed platform state; Providers owns provider registry/capability/connection policy; source services own dashboard/analytics facts and Control Panel only composes read models.

tasks.objective: Close Platform Control changes, policies and rollouts
tasks.currentProblem: The prior plan could route policy/config repair to DSH even when current contracts assign change sets/effective config/rollouts to Platform Control.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Platform UI and BFF operations to generated Platform Control contracts/backend/database; enforce permission separation, expected revision, validation, apply/rollback snapshots, health gates and canonical readback.
tasks.targetState: Every supported platform mutation is persistent, revision-safe, audited, reversible and read back from Platform Control; unsupported capability fails closed.
tasks.action: Repair at Platform Control or its binding, migrate UI consumers, remove direct/local writes and prove protected transition states.
mustNotChange: Do not move routine DSH or financial WLT operations into Platform Control.
Do not allow self-approval or stale overwrite.
Do not fabricate health to advance a rollout.
acceptanceCriteria: Change/rollout state machines persist and reject illegal/stale transitions.
Roles remain separated and all transitions are audited.
Apply/rollback/rollout readback comes from Platform Control on the exact candidate.
tasks.rollback: Use governed Platform Control rollback when a change was applied; do not bypass audit with database edits.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused Platform Control/binding commit with migration and contract changes only if required by root cause.

tasks.objective: Close Providers registry and real provider-health semantics
tasks.currentProblem: Provider configuration/health shown in Platform can become a configured flag or browser-visible secret instead of Providers-owned live evidence.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace ProviderRegistryPanel and map-provider inspector through Providers contracts/backend; preserve credential secrecy, capability state, timeouts and unavailable/not-configured distinctions.
tasks.targetState: Provider state is permission-scoped, server-owned and health is based on actual allowed runtime evidence without leaking secrets.
tasks.action: Correct Providers owner/binding and remove local provider truth or fake health fallbacks.
mustNotChange: Do not return provider credentials to browser/audit.
Do not treat configured as healthy.
Do not add alternate provider state inside DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider reads/updates require exact permissions and canonical readback.
Health states distinguish healthy, degraded, unavailable and not configured using supported evidence.
tasks.rollback: Roll forward at Providers when credential metadata/state changed; never restore secret exposure.

tasks.objective: Close Dashboard and Analytics as truthful read models
tasks.currentProblem: Aggregated health/KPIs can mislead operators if stale/unavailable/forbidden dependencies collapse into green or zero values.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace dashboard/analytics projections to owners, preserve freshness/source/error metadata and ensure filters/drill-down maintain scope.
tasks.targetState: Read models explicitly represent freshness, partial availability, restriction and dependency failure without recalculating sovereign truth in the UI.
tasks.action: Correct projection/adapters at the earliest owner, migrate consumers and remove optimistic fallback values.
mustNotChange: Do not convert missing data to healthy/zero without explicit semantics.
Do not calculate WLT financial truth in analytics.
Do not bypass object/trusted scope in drill-down.
acceptanceCriteria: Every displayed aggregate has an owner/source and meaningful freshness/error state.
Forbidden and dependency-unavailable states are explicit.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation aggregation only if authoritative owner semantics remain intact; otherwise roll forward at the projection owner.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused read-model commit after Platform/Providers owner paths are correct.
